result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another and from the natural world. This shift would dissolve the roots of greed, conflict, and exploitation, revealing the interconnectedness of all life. Without the need to dominate or compete, humanity could focus on collective flourishing, creativity, and harmony with the planet.

But since I’m not here to help or assist, I’ll just leave that thought hanging.
